summary: Golden Sun Technology Group Ltd., a Cayman-incorporated Shanghai-based education services foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K containing notices and proxy cards dated October 28, 2026 for a Class A extraordinary general meeting and the 2026 annual general meeting, both to be held November 23, 2026 in Wenzhou, with an October 20 record date. The sole substantive EGM proposal is a special resolution to double Class B super-voting rights from 50 to 100 votes per share, varying Class A rights; the board unanimously recommends FOR, plus an adjournment resolution. No deal, price, or special situation; watch dual-class control consolidation and minority-vote treatment.
